title: Hack the Hub: Automaton
description:
Before the 2027 season starts, we’re spending December rebuilding the Hub’s digital backbone. Builders, tinkerers and commons nerds come together to automate the boring parts, so the people here can put their energy into community instead of admin.

What we’re building

Website and event pages
Booking and ticketing
Bookkeeping
A shared database as one source of truth
Social media

Work-for-stay
Put in about 4 hours a day and your bed and food are free.

Winter at the Hub

Christmas cookies, a warm house, shared celebrations
19–21 Dec: winter solstice, a wholesome celebration that includes a gong night

After the hack
Some of us head straight on to CCC, the Chaos Communication Congress in Hamburg, from 27-30th of Dec, where we’re part of the Intersect habitat, so you can hack here and carry on there. After that, back to the Hub, for a 5 day holistic new year party from 30th Dec to 3rd Jan.
milestones: build an automated Hub & Valley Wiki + info agent
build an agentic ecosystem that automates admin work for the Hub: Accounting, Ticketing, Occupancy Plan, Social Media / Newsletter, etc
